style_notes: Late delivery penalty: call it liquidated damages and do not use the word "penalty" for this term.
Volume discount: do not use the words "discount", "rebate" or "reduction" for this term. Call it a price adjustment, a credit or another natural name of your own choice.
extra_decoys: The Buyer may withhold 5% of the value of each invoice as retention until acceptance testing of the Equipment has been completed.
